name: Nexus-1MD
description: A lightweight, customizable, multi-functional WhatsApp automation bot built with Baileys.

SESSION_ID.description: Your unique bot session ID string generated on login (starts with NEXUS~).

SUDO.description: Primary Super-Admin phone number with country code (e.g. 254797715445).

OWNERS.description: Additional owner phone numbers separated by commas (e.g. 254711111111,254722222222).

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: Phone number with country code to generate a pairing code instead of scanning a QR code.
